properties.name: Bhavana
properties.Method_Description: Bhavana is the process of triturating a powdered drug with liquid media such as herbal juice, decoction, cow urine, milk, or other prescribed liquids. Grinding continues until the liquid is completely absorbed and the material becomes soft and homogeneous. This process helps detoxify, enhance potency, and incorporate the therapeutic properties of the liquid medium into the drug.

properties.name: Swedana
properties.Method_Description: Swedana involves heating the raw material in a liquid medium using mild heat, usually by boiling or steaming (often in a Dolayantra setup). The process removes impurities, reduces toxicity, softens the material, and facilitates further purification or processing.

properties.name: Nimajjana
properties.Method_Description: Nimajjana is the immersion of a substance in a specific liquid medium for a fixed duration. This allows soluble impurities or toxic components to leach out into the liquid, making the material safer and easier to process.

properties.name: Mardana
properties.Method_Description: Mardana is dry or semi-wet grinding of substances in a mortar and pestle, sometimes with minimal liquid. It reduces particle size, improves homogeneity, and may help reduce toxicity by physical transformation and intimate mixing.

properties.name: Bharjana
properties.Method_Description: Bharjana is heating the drug in a pan, often without liquid or with minimal ghee or sand, until desired color or texture changes occur. This process removes moisture, reduces toxicity, and improves digestibility and stability.

properties.name: Dhalana
properties.Method_Description: In Dhalana, a substance is melted and then poured into a liquid medium such as oil, milk, or herbal decoction. The sudden cooling helps remove impurities and alter the physical structure, improving safety and medicinal properties.

properties.name: Nirvapa
properties.Method_Description: Nirvapa involves heating the material until red hot and then quenching it immediately in a liquid medium. This cycle may be repeated multiple times. It reduces hardness and toxicity, enhances brittleness, and facilitates further processing.

properties.name: Urdhva Patana
properties.Method_Description: Urdhva Patana Shodhana is a purification method in which the volatile purified component is separated from impurities by upward sublimation and collected in an upper vessel through controlled heating.

properties.name: Bhavana with heating
properties.Method_Description: This is a modified Bhavana where trituration with liquid media is combined with gentle heating. Heat accelerates chemical transformations, enhances absorption of the liquid medium, and improves detoxification and therapeutic efficacy.

properties.name: Nisechana
properties.Method_Description: Nisechana is the process of rapidly cooling a heated material by immersing it in a liquid medium, which helps remove impurities and improves its physical properties for further processing.

properties.name: Nirmalikarana
properties.Method_Description: It is a specialized Shodhana process involving the dissolution, filtration, and recrystallization of a substance to remove physical impurities and obtain a purified crystalline product.

properties.name: Prakshalana
properties.Method_Description: Prakshalana is the process of thoroughly washing a drug with water or other prescribed liquids to remove surface impurities, dirt, soluble toxins, and unwanted residues.

properties.Description: Samanya Shodhana (General purification) is the preliminary, common purification step applied to many metals, minerals, and toxic herbs using standard media such as water, cow urine, milk, oil, or herbal decoctions. Its purpose is to remove visible impurities, reduce basic toxicity, and make the material softer and suitable for further processing.
properties.name: Samanya Shodhana

properties.Description: Vishesh Shodhana (Specific purification) is the drug-specific purification performed after Samanya Shodhana. It uses special media and procedures tailored to a particular substance to eliminate its unique toxic components and enhance its therapeutic safety and efficacy.
properties.name: Vishesha Shodhana

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Process_Description: Dhanyabhraka is a special purification method for mica in which powdered mica is mixed with rice grains, tied in cloth, and soaked or rubbed in water. The fine mica particles pass through the cloth while heavier impurities remain behind.
properties.name: Dhanyabhraka

properties.Process_Description: Amritikarana is a post-processing step applied to prepared Bhasma using ghee or herbal substances and mild heating. It is done to remove any residual toxicity, improve safety, and enhance therapeutic potency.
properties.name: Amritikarana

properties.Process_Description: Bhanupaka involves triturating the drug with liquid media and exposing it to sunlight. The mild heat and UV exposure promote slow drying and gentle chemical transformation.
properties.name: Bhanupaka

properties.Process_Description: Sthalipaka is cooking the drug with specific liquid media in a vessel over fire until the liquid evaporates. This helps detoxify the material and incorporate medicinal properties from the medium.
properties.name: Sthalipaka

properties.Process_Description: Dhavana is the repeated washing of a substance with water or other liquids to remove soluble impurities, dirt, and unwanted soluble components.
properties.name: Dhavana

properties.Process_Description: Jarana is roasting metals or minerals with herbal powders or other additives until they become brittle and powdery. It reduces hardness and prepares the substance for incineration (Marana).
properties.name: Jarana

properties.Process_Description: Prakshalana is the process of thoroughly washing a drug with water or other prescribed liquids to remove surface impurities, dirt, soluble toxins, and unwanted residues. It is usually performed as a preliminary or intermediate purification step before further processing.
properties.name: Prakshalana

properties.Process_Description: Bhavana is wet grinding of powdered drugs with herbal juices or decoctions until the liquid is fully absorbed. This enhances detoxification, potency, and homogeneity.
properties.name: Bhavana

properties.Process_Description: Lohitikarana is a treatment process that gives certain Bhasmas a reddish color through controlled heating and media treatment, indicating proper processing and improved therapeutic quality.
properties.name: Lohitikarana

properties.Description: Acute prolapsed inter-vertebral disc (IVDP) is a painful condition that requires immediate treatment by conservative or surgical management. Though majority of patients show remission in symptoms with conservative treatment, regression of herniated disc with non-surgical management has been rarely reported.
properties.name: Acute Prolapsed Inter-Vertebral Disc

properties.Description: Acute upper limb ischemia (AULI) is a medical and surgical emergency involving sudden decrease in limb perfusion resulting in threat for limb viability. The approximate incidence of AULI is 1.5 cases/10,000 people per year.
properties.name: Acute Upper Limb Ischemia

properties.Description: Alopecia is the medical term for hair loss. It can mean small round patches missing from the scalp (alopecia areata), total loss of head hair (alopecia totalis), or loss of all body hair (alopecia universalis).
properties.name: Alopecia

properties.Description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) affects human life in various ways. ALS with multifocal onset might exhibit muscle stiffness and muscle weakness of upper and lower limbs, muscle twitching, atrophy, falling/tripping, slurred speech, difficulty in swallowing and loss of dexterity.
properties.name: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis

properties.Description: Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) is a chronic inflammatory disorder that primarily involves the sacroiliac joints and the axial skeleton. There is also a variable involvement of peripheral joints and articular structures.
properties.name: Ankylosing Spondylitis

properties.Description: Anti-phospholipid antibody (APLA) syndrome is defined by the presence of thrombo-embolic complications and pregnancy morbidity in the presence of persistently increased titers of APLA syndrome.
properties.name: Antiphospholipid Antibody Syndrome

properties.Description: AIP is a rare disorder, its exact cause is unknown, but it is thought to be caused by the body's immune system attacking the pancreas and it responds to steroid therapy only.
properties.name: Autoimmune Pancreatitis

properties.Description: Avascular necrosis (AVN) of the bone is a condition characterized by the death or necrosis of bone tissue, accompanied by structural changes. It is also referred to as osteonecrosis or ischemic necrosis of the bone. It is mostly seen in patients having a history of excessive alcohol and high-dose steroid medications.
properties.name: Avascular Necrosis

properties.Description: Bell's palsy or Facial nerve palsy is a condition that causes temporary weakness or paralysis of the muscles in the face.
properties.name: Bell's Palsy

properties.Description: BPH is a nonmalignant enlargement of the prostate gland caused by excessive growth of the prostatic tissue and is the most common benign neoplasm of aging men mainly above 40 years.
properties.name: Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia

properties.Description: Bleeding piles (hemorrhoids) are swollen, inflamed blood vessels in the rectum or anus that often produce painless, bright red blood during bowel movements.
properties.name: Bleeding Piles

properties.Description: Bronchial asthma is a long-term lung disease that inflames and narrows the airways. It causes recurring bouts of wheezing, chest tightness, shortness of breath, and coughing.
properties.name: Bronchial Asthma

properties.Description: Central serous retinopathy (CSR), or central serous chorioretinopathy, occurs when fluid leaks under the retina, forming a small detachment that blurs or distorts central vision.
properties.name: Central Serous Retinopathy

properties.Description: Cerebral palsy is a group of permanent movement and posture disorders caused by abnormal development or damage to the developing brain, usually before or during birth.
properties.name: Cerebral Palsy

properties.Description: Cervical spondylosis is a degenerative condition of the cervical spine caused by age-related changes in the vertebrae, intervertebral discs, and surrounding structures. It may cause neck pain, stiffness, and restricted movement.
properties.name: Cervical Spondylosis

properties.Description: Cervical spondylotic myelopathy is a neurological condition caused by compression of the spinal cord due to degenerative changes in the cervical spine. It may result in weakness, sensory disturbances, impaired coordination, and difficulty walking.
properties.name: Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy

properties.Description: Chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy is nerve damage resulting from certain anticancer drugs. It commonly presents with numbness, tingling, burning pain, weakness, or altered sensation, particularly in the hands and feet.
properties.name: Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy

properties.Description: Chronic alcoholism refers to prolonged and excessive alcohol consumption associated with dependence and adverse physical, psychological, and social consequences. It can affect multiple organs and may lead to neurological and metabolic complications.
properties.name: Chronic Alchoholism

properties.Description: Chronic low back pain is persistent or recurrent pain affecting the lower back for an extended period. It may be associated with spinal degeneration, muscular problems, nerve involvement, or other underlying conditions.
properties.name: Chronic Low Back Pain

properties.Description: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia is a type of blood cancer characterized by the abnormal accumulation of mature but functionally impaired lymphocytes, most commonly B lymphocytes. It generally progresses slowly and may initially produce few symptoms.
properties.name: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia

properties.Description: A chronic non-healing ulcer is a wound that fails to heal through the normal stages of tissue repair. It may persist because of factors such as poor blood supply, infection, diabetes, or repeated trauma.
properties.name: Chronic Non-Healing Ulcer

properties.Description: Chronic sinusitis is persistent inflammation of the paranasal sinuses lasting for an extended period. It commonly causes nasal obstruction, nasal discharge, facial pressure or pain, and reduced sense of smell.
properties.name: Chronic Sinusitis

properties.Description: Chronic urticaria is a condition characterized by recurrent episodes of itchy wheals (hives), with or without swelling, occurring without a consistently identifiable external trigger.
properties.name: Chronic Urticaria

properties.Description: Coma is a prolonged state of profound unconsciousness in which an individual cannot be awakened and does not respond normally to external stimuli. It may result from severe brain injury, stroke, metabolic disturbances, poisoning, or other serious conditions.
properties.name: Coma

properties.Description: COVID-19 is an infectious disease caused by the severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). It primarily affects the respiratory system but can involve multiple organs and produce symptoms ranging from mild illness to severe disease.
properties.name: Covid-19

properties.Description: Depression is a mental health disorder characterized by persistent sadness or low mood, loss of interest or pleasure, and associated emotional, cognitive, behavioural, and physical symptoms that can interfere with daily functioning.
properties.name: Depression

properties.Description: Diabetes mellitus is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by elevated blood glucose levels resulting from inadequate insulin production, impaired insulin action, or a combination of both. Persistent hyperglycaemia can lead to complications affecting multiple organs.
properties.name: Diabetes Mellitus

properties.Description: A diabetic foot ulcer is a chronic open wound occurring on the foot in individuals with diabetes. It is commonly associated with diabetic neuropathy, impaired circulation, and delayed wound healing.
properties.name: Diabetic Foot Ulcer

properties.Description: Diabetic retinopathy is a complication of diabetes that affects the blood vessels of the retina. Progressive retinal damage can cause visual disturbances and, in advanced cases, significant vision loss.
properties.name: Diabetic Retinopathy

properties.Description: Diplopia, commonly known as double vision, is a visual disturbance in which a person perceives two images of a single object. It may occur due to abnormalities involving the eyes, ocular muscles, or the nerves controlling eye movement.
properties.name: Diplopia

properties.Description: Dyslipidemia is an abnormal level or composition of lipids in the blood, including elevated cholesterol or triglycerides and/or reduced high-density lipoprotein cholesterol. It is an important risk factor for cardiovascular disease.
properties.name: Dyslipidemia

properties.Description: Dysmenorrhea refers to painful menstruation, typically characterized by cramping pain in the lower abdomen during the menstrual period. It may also be accompanied by symptoms such as backache, nausea, or fatigue.
properties.name: Dysmenorrhea

properties.Description: Dysuria refers to painful, burning, or uncomfortable urination. It is commonly associated with infections or inflammation of the urinary tract but may occur due to other urinary or genital conditions.
properties.name: Dysuria

properties.Description: Eczema is a skin disorder characterized by Itching erythema, Scaling, Edema, vesiculation, and Discharge
properties.name: Eczema

properties.Description: Endometrial calcification refers to the abnormal deposition of calcium within the endometrial lining of the uterus.
properties.name: Endometrial Calcification

properties.Description: An endometrioma is a cyst formed when endometrial-like tissue grows within the ovary, commonly resulting from endometriosis.
properties.name: Endometrioma

properties.Description: Epidermolysis bullosa (EB) is a group of inherited rare skin disorders that causes the skin to become fragile and blister easily due to minor trauma or friction.
properties.name: Epidermolysis Bullosa

properties.Description: Episodic cluster headache is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent attacks of severe, usually one-sided headache, often accompanied by symptoms such as tearing, nasal congestion, or redness of the eye on the affected side.
properties.name: Episodic Cluster Headache

properties.Description: Psoriasis is a noninfectious chronic inflammatory skin disorder, characterized by well-defined erythematous plaques with silvery scales.
properties.name: Erythrodermic Psoriasis

properties.Description: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma is a malignant tumor arising from the squamous epithelial cells lining the esophagus.
properties.name: Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma

properties.Description: Female infertility is the inability to achieve pregnancy after regular unprotected sexual intercourse for a defined period.
properties.name: Female Infertility

properties.Description: A fracture is a partial or complete break in the continuity of a bone, usually caused by trauma, excessive stress, or weakened bone. It may present with pain, swelling, deformity, and restricted movement.
properties.name: Fracture

properties.Description: Glaucoma is a group of eye disorders characterized by progressive damage to the optic nerve, often associated with elevated intraocular pressure.
properties.name: Glaucoma

properties.Description: Guillain Barre Syndrome (GB syndrome), a rare disease condition in which body’s immune system attacks part of the peripheral nervous system.
properties.name: Guillain-Barre Syndrome

properties.Description: Hemifacial spasm is a neurological disorder characterized by involuntary, intermittent contractions or twitching of the muscles on one side of the face.
properties.name: Hemifacial Spasm

properties.Description: Hepatitis B is a viral infection caused by the hepatitis B virus (HBV), primarily affecting the liver. It can cause acute or chronic liver inflammation and, in persistent cases, may lead to cirrhosis or liver cancer.
properties.name: Hepatitis B

properties.Description: Hirschsprung's disease is a congenital disorder in which certain portions of the large intestine lack normal nerve cells, resulting in impaired movement of intestinal contents.
properties.name: Hirschsprung'S Disease

properties.Description: Huntington's chorea is an inherited neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive movement abnormalities, particularly involuntary jerky movements called chorea, along with cognitive and psychiatric changes.
properties.name: Huntington’S Chorea

properties.Description: Hyperlipidemia refers to abnormally elevated levels of lipids in the blood, particularly cholesterol and triglycerides.
properties.name: Hyperlipidemia

properties.Description: Hypertension is a chronic condition in which blood pressure remains persistently elevated above the normal range.
properties.name: Hypertension

properties.Description: Juvenile spondyloarthritis is a group of inflammatory rheumatic disorders affecting children and adolescents, involving the joints and often the spine or areas where tendons attach to bone. It may cause pain, stiffness, swelling, and restricted movement.
properties.name: Juvenile Spondyloarthritis

properties.Description: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy is a group of inherited muscle disorders characterized by progressive weakness of the muscles around the hips and shoulders.
properties.name: Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophy

properties.Description: Liver cirrhosis with ascites refers to advanced scarring of the liver accompanied by accumulation of fluid within the abdominal cavity.
properties.name: Liver Cirrhosis With Ascites

properties.Description: A low anti-Müllerian hormone level indicates reduced levels of AMH, a hormone produced by ovarian follicles and commonly used as a marker of ovarian reserve.
properties.name: Low Anti-Mullerian Hormone (Amh) Level

properties.Description: Lumbar disc herniation occurs when the inner material of an intervertebral disc protrudes through a weakened or damaged outer layer in the lower spine.
properties.name: Lumbar Disc Herniation

properties.Description: Lumbar myelomeningocele is a congenital neural tube defect in which the spinal cord and its coverings protrude through an opening in the lumbar vertebrae.
properties.name: Lumbar Myelomeningocele

properties.Description: Lumbar spondylosis is a degenerative condition of the lumbar spine involving age-related changes in the vertebrae, discs, and facet joints. It may cause chronic low back pain, stiffness, and sometimes nerve-related symptoms.
properties.name: Lumbar Spondylosis

properties.Description: Major depressive disorder is a mental health condition characterized by persistent depressed mood or loss of interest or pleasure, accompanied by emotional, cognitive, and physical symptoms that significantly affect daily functioning.
properties.name: Major Depressive Disorder

properties.Description: Meibomian gland dysfunction is a disorder in which the oil-producing meibomian glands of the eyelids do not function normally. It can destabilize the tear film and cause dry, irritated, burning, or gritty eyes.
properties.name: Meibomian Gland Dysfunction

properties.Description: Migraine is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent attacks of moderate to severe headache, often accompanied by nausea and sensitivity to light or sound.
properties.name: Migraine

properties.Description: Myopia, or short-sightedness, is a refractive error in which distant objects appear blurred because light is focused in front of the retina rather than directly on it.
properties.name: Myopia

properties.Description: Nicolau syndrome is a rare injection-related complication characterized by severe pain and skin changes occurring shortly after administration of an injection.
properties.name: Nicolau Syndrome

properties.Description: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease is a condition characterized by excessive accumulation of fat in the liver in people without significant alcohol consumption.
properties.name: Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease

properties.Description: Non-progress of labor refers to failure of labor to advance normally, such as inadequate cervical dilation or descent of the fetus despite ongoing labor.
properties.name: Non-Progess Of Labor

properties.Description: Obesity is a chronic condition characterized by excessive accumulation of body fat that may adversely affect health.
properties.name: Obesity

properties.Description: Oligoasthenozoospermia is a male reproductive condition characterized by reduced sperm concentration (oligozoospermia) together with reduced sperm motility (asthenozoospermia).
properties.name: Oligoasthenozoospermia

properties.Description: Oligomenorrhea refers to menstrual periods that occur at unusually long intervals, resulting in infrequent menstruation.
properties.name: Oligomenorrhea

properties.Description: Oligo-teratozoospermia is a condition affecting the normal sperm count and morphology leading to male factor infertility
properties.name: Oligo-Teratozoospermia

properties.Description: Oligozoospermia is a male reproductive condition characterized by a lower-than-normal concentration of sperm in the semen.
properties.name: Oligozoospermia

properties.Description: Oral submucous fibrosis is a chronic progressive disorder of the oral cavity characterized by inflammation and fibrosis of the mucosal tissues.
properties.name: Oral Submucous Fibrosis

properties.Description: Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disorder characterized by progressive deterioration of articular cartilage and changes in the underlying bone. It commonly causes joint pain, stiffness, swelling, and restricted movement.
properties.name: Osteoarthritis

properties.Description: Osteoporosis is a skeletal disorder characterized by reduced bone strength and increased susceptibility to fractures. It commonly affects the spine, hip, and wrist.
properties.name: Osteoporosis

properties.Description: An ovarian cyst is a fluid-filled or solid sac that develops within or on the surface of an ovary.
properties.name: Ovarian Cyst

properties.Description: Papilledema is swelling of the optic disc caused by increased intracranial pressure.
properties.name: Papilledema

properties.Description: Polycystic ovarian disease is a condition characterized by multiple small follicles or cyst-like structures in the ovaries, often associated with hormonal and menstrual disturbances.
properties.name: Poly Cystic Ovarian Disease

properties.Description: Polycystic ovarian syndrome is a common endocrine disorder characterized by hormonal imbalance, irregular or absent ovulation, and clinical or biochemical features of excess androgen.
properties.name: Poly Cystic Ovarian Syndrome

properties.Description: Post-traumatic trigeminal neuropathy is a disorder of the trigeminal nerve that develops following trauma or injury. It may cause persistent facial pain, numbness, tingling, or altered sensation in the affected area.
properties.name: Post-Traumatic Trigeminal Neuropathy

properties.Description: Post-traumatic trigeminal neuropathy is a disorder of the trigeminal nerve that develops following trauma or injury. It may cause persistent facial pain, numbness, tingling, or altered sensation in the affected area.
properties.name: Prediabetes

properties.Description: Primary insomnia refers to persistent difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or obtaining restorative sleep that is not primarily explained by another medical or psychiatric condition.
properties.name: Primary Insomnia

properties.Description: Progressive bulbar palsy is a neurodegenerative disorder affecting the motor neurons controlling the muscles involved in speech, swallowing, and facial movements.
properties.name: Progressive Bulbar Palsy

properties.Description: Progressive supranuclear palsy is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by problems with balance, movement, eye movements, and postural control.
properties.name: Progressive Supranuclear Palsy

properties.Description: Prurigo nodularis is a chronic skin disorder characterized by intensely itchy, firm nodules that develop as a result of persistent scratching or rubbing. The lesions commonly occur on the arms, legs, and trunk.
properties.name: Prurigo Nodularis

properties.Description: Psoriasis is a chronic immune-mediated inflammatory skin disorder characterized by well-demarcated, scaly plaques. It commonly affects the scalp, elbows, knees, and other areas and may also involve the joints.
properties.name: Psoriasis

properties.Description: Rheumatoid arthritis is a chronic autoimmune inflammatory disorder that primarily affects the joints. It commonly causes symmetrical joint pain, swelling, stiffness, and progressive joint damage.
properties.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis

properties.Description: Sciatica refers to pain along the distribution of the sciatic nerve, usually caused by irritation or compression of a nerve root in the lower spine. It commonly produces pain radiating from the lower back or buttock into the leg.
properties.name: Sciatica

properties.Description: Sclerosis refers to abnormal hardening or thickening of tissue due to pathological changes, such as fibrosis or scarring. The term can describe several different conditions depending on the affected tissue or organ.
properties.name: Sclerosis

properties.Description: Sinusitis is inflammation of the paranasal sinuses, often associated with nasal congestion, facial pressure or pain, nasal discharge, and reduced sense of smell.
properties.name: Sinusitis

properties.Description: Small fibre neuropathy is a disorder affecting small sensory and autonomic nerve fibres. It commonly causes burning pain, tingling, altered temperature or pain sensation, and sometimes autonomic symptoms.
properties.name: Small Fibre Neuropathy

properties.Description: Spinal cord injury is damage to the spinal cord resulting from trauma or other causes, potentially leading to impaired motor, sensory, and autonomic functions below the site of injury.
properties.name: Spinal Cord Injury

properties.Description: Spinocerebellar ataxia refers to a group of inherited neurodegenerative disorders characterized by progressive impairment of coordination and balance due to dysfunction of the cerebellum and related neural pathways.
properties.name: Spinocerebellar Ataxia

properties.Description: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 2 is an inherited neurodegenerative disorder caused by a genetic mutation affecting the nervous system.
properties.name: Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 2

properties.Description: Spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia tarda is a rare inherited skeletal disorder primarily affecting the spine and the growth and development of the ends of long bones.
properties.name: Spondyloepiphyseal Dysplasia Tarda

properties.Description: Takayasu arteritis is a rare large-vessel inflammatory disease that primarily affects the aorta and its major branches.
properties.name: Takayasu Arteritis

properties.Description: Traumatic optic neuropathy is damage to the optic nerve resulting from trauma to the head or eye. It can cause sudden or progressive reduction in vision and other visual disturbances.
properties.name: Traumatic Optic Neuropathy

properties.Description: Trigeminal neuralgia is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent, sudden episodes of severe, brief, electric-shock-like pain affecting one or more branches of the trigeminal nerve, usually on one side of the face.
properties.name: Trigeminal Neuralgia

properties.Description: Tubal blockage refers to obstruction of one or both fallopian tubes, preventing normal movement of the egg and sperm through the reproductive tract. It is an important cause of female infertility.
properties.name: Tubal Blockage

properties.Description: Type 2 diabetes is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by elevated blood glucose levels due primarily to insulin resistance and progressive impairment of insulin secretion.
properties.name: Type 2 Diabetes

properties.Description: Type 2 diabetes mellitus is the same metabolic condition commonly referred to as type 2 diabetes, characterized by persistent hyperglycaemia resulting from insulin resistance and inadequate insulin secretion.
properties.name: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

properties.Description: Ulcerative colitis is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease characterized by inflammation and ulceration of the lining of the colon and rectum. It commonly causes abdominal pain, diarrhoea, rectal bleeding, and urgency.
properties.name: Ulcerative Colitis

properties.Description: Ulcerative keratitis is an inflammatory condition of the cornea associated with corneal ulceration. It may cause eye pain, redness, photophobia, tearing, and impaired vision and requires prompt medical attention.
properties.name: Ulcerative Keratitis

properties.Description: Urethral stricture is abnormal narrowing of the urethra caused by scar tissue or other structural changes. It can obstruct urinary flow and cause difficulty or discomfort during urination.
properties.name: Urethral Stricture

properties.Description: Urinary incontinence is the involuntary leakage of urine due to impaired control of bladder storage or emptying.
properties.name: Urinary Incontinence

properties.Description: Uterine fibroid is not only the commonest benign tumour of uterus but also the commonest solid tumour in female that usually found in approximately 20 to 40% women of reproductive age group,1 start as multiple, single cell seedlings distributed throughout the uterine wall.
properties.name: Uterine Fibroids

properties.Description: Vasculitis is chronic inflammation resulting in necrosis of blood vessels due to narrowing or occlusion of the lumen.
properties.name: Vasculitis

properties.Description: A venous ulcer is a chronic wound that commonly develops on the lower leg due to impaired venous circulation and increased pressure within the veins. It is often associated with swelling, skin changes, and poor wound healing.
properties.name: Venous Ulcer

properties.Description: A wound is a disruption or injury to the normal structure and integrity of body tissue, usually involving the skin or underlying tissues. It may result from trauma, surgery, infection, or other pathological processes.
properties.name: Wounds

properties.Description: Pityriasis rubra pilaris is a rare chronic inflammatory skin disorder characterized by reddish-orange scaly patches, follicular papules, and areas of relatively normal skin. It may involve the scalp, face, trunk, and limbs.
properties.name: Pityriasis Rubra Pilaris

properties.Description: An acute renal calculus refers to the sudden clinical presentation of a kidney stone, formed by crystallization of substances within the urinary tract.
properties.name: Acute Renal Calculus

properties.Description: Rett syndrome is a rare genetic neurodevelopmental disorder that primarily affects females. It is characterized by normal early development followed by loss of acquired skills, impaired communication, repetitive hand movements, and problems with coordination.
properties.name: Rett Syndrome

properties.Description: Neurogenic bladder is a dysfunction of bladder storage or emptying caused by abnormalities of the nervous system. It may result in urinary retention, urgency, frequency, or involuntary urine leakage.
properties.name: Neurogenic Bladder

properties.Description: Knee osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disorder involving progressive deterioration of the cartilage and other structures of the knee. It commonly causes knee pain, stiffness, swelling, and difficulty with movement or walking
properties.name: Knee Osteoarthritis

properties.Description: Irritable bowel syndrome is a functional gastrointestinal disorder characterized by recurrent abdominal pain associated with changes in bowel habits, including diarrhoea, constipation, or both, without an identifiable structural cause.
properties.name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome

properties.Description: A lumbo-sacral disorder refers to a condition affecting the lumbar and sacral regions of the lower spine. It may cause lower back pain, stiffness, restricted movement, or nerve-related symptoms affecting the lower limbs.
properties.name: Lumbo-Sacral Disorder

properties.Description: Piles, also known as haemorrhoids, are swollen and enlarged veins in the lower rectum or anus. They may cause rectal bleeding, discomfort, itching, or a lump around the anal region.
properties.name: Piles

properties.Description: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is the gradual irreversible damage to kidney function that occurs in both kidneys. This disease is marked by a sustained kidney damage or decreased functioning for at least three months.
properties.name: Chronic Kidney Disease

properties.Description: Lumbar spinal stenosis is abnormal narrowing of spinal canal at lumbar region, may occur as a result of progression of spondylotic changes.
properties.name: Lumbar Spinal Stenosis

properties.Description: Diabetic neuropathy symptoms include pain, numbness, reduced sensation of touch or oversensitivity, uncomfortable tingling and burning, skin ulcer and reduced reflexes.
properties.name: Diabetic Neuropathy

properties.Description: A child with global developmental delay is unable to attain developmental milestones owing to brain damage which leads to impairment in gross and fine motor, personal social, speech, and activities of daily living.
properties.name: Global Developmental Delay

properties.Description: Haemorrhoids are swollen and enlarged veins in the lower rectum or anus. They may cause rectal bleeding, pain or discomfort, itching, and swelling around the anal region.
properties.name: Haemorrhoids

properties.Description: Post-thrombotic syndrome is a chronic complication of deep vein thrombosis caused by damage to the veins and their valves.
properties.name: Post-Thrombotic Syndrome

properties.Description: Fibromyalgia (FM) is a or musculoskeletal condition characterized by chronic widespread musculoskeletal pain and tenderness including associated neuropsychological symptoms including fatigue, unrefreshing sleep, cognitive dysfunction, anxiety, and depression.
properties.name: Fibromyalgia

properties.Description: Bipolar Affective Disorder (BPAD) is a recurrent and chronic disorder that is characterized by episodes of depression and elevated mood with intervening periods of normal mood.
properties.name: Bipolar Affective Disorder

properties.Description: Adhesive capsulitis often referred to as frozen shoulder, is one of the long term complication of Diabetes mellitus which causes gradual loss of motion in shoulder.
properties.name: Adhesive Capsulitis Stage 2

properties.Description: Necrozoospermia (also called necrospermia) is a rare semen disorder where most or all of the sperm present in a semen sample are dead or non-viable.
properties.name: Necrozoospermia

properties.Description: Vipadika or Vaipadika is explained as one among Eleven Kshudra Kushtas (Minor skin ailments) which has the features of Paanipaada sputana (Cracking of palms and soles) associated with Teevravedana (Intense pain) as explained by Acharya Charaka.
properties.name: Vipadika

properties.Description: Hemiplegia is the commonest manifestation of a Stroke with neurological deficit affecting the face, limbs and trunk on one side or either side of the body.
properties.name: Hemiplegia

properties.Description: Lumbar disc disease (LDD) is a common cause of chronic or recurrent low back and leg pain, most frequently affecting the L4–L5 and L5–S1 levels. The pain may be localized to the lower back or may radiate to the leg, buttocks, or hip.
properties.name: Lumbar Disc Disease

properties.Description: Hirayama disease (HD) is a juvenile nonprogressive amyotrophy disease. It is characterized by gradual onset of muscular dystrophy in the distal part of the upper limbs related to flexion movements of the cervical spine.
properties.name: Hirayama Disease

properties.Description: Infertility is the inability to achieve pregnancy after regular unprotected sexual intercourse for a specified period. It may result from factors affecting ovulation, reproductive organs, sperm function, hormonal balance, or other reproductive factors.
properties.name: Infertility

properties.Description: Senile dementia is a syndrome due to disease of the brain, usually of a chronic or progressive nature, in which there is disturbance of multiple higher cortical functions, without any impairment in consciousness. Prevalence rates for senile dementia increase essentially with advancing age.
properties.name: Senile Dementia

properties.Description: Psoriasis vulgaris, commonly known as plaque psoriasis, is the most frequent form of an autoimmune skin condition. It causes the rapid buildup of skin cells, leading to raised, inflamed patches covered with silvery-white or gray scales.
properties.name: Psoriasis Vulgaris

properties.Description: Visphota Kushta is a traditional Ayurvedic classification for blistering skin diseases characterized by thin-skinned, transparent, or fluid-filled vesicles and bullae.
properties.name: Visphota Kushta

properties.Description: Ayurvedic description of inability or difficulty in obtaining normal sleep, commonly associated with aggravated Vata and disturbed mental factors.
properties.name: Anidra

properties.Description: A disorder in which Apana Vata obstructs the normal functioning of Vyana Vata, leading to disturbed movement and circulation-related functions.
properties.name: Apanavrita Vyanavata

properties.Description: A Vata-dominant headache disorder characterized by severe pain affecting one half of the head, often occurring episodically.
properties.name: Ardhavabhedaka

properties.Description: In Ayurveda, Ardita is a disease with functional disturbances affecting the Uthamanga (head) and stands close with the symptoms of Bell's palsy. It is narrated as one among the Asheeti Vata Vikaras (80 types of typical vata predominant diseases).
properties.name: Ardita

properties.Description: A disorder characterized by reduced quantity or deficient formation of Artava (menstrual tissue), often presenting with scanty or delayed menstruation.
properties.name: Artava Kshaya

properties.Description: A state of depletion of Asthi (bone tissue) and Majja (marrow/nerve-related tissue) associated with weakness and degenerative manifestations.
properties.name: Asthi-Majja Kshaya

properties.Description: A Vata disorder in which aggravated Vata is located in the bone and marrow tissues, producing pain, weakness, and degenerative symptoms.
properties.name: Asthimajjagata-Vata

properties.Description: Pathological disturbance of the channels responsible for nourishment and functioning of bone tissue (Asthi).
properties.name: Asthivaha Srotodushti

properties.Description: Vata disorders produced by obstruction of the normal movement of Vata by another Dosha, tissue, or bodily factor.
properties.name: Avarana Janya Vata Vyadhi

properties.Description: A Vata disorder resulting from trauma to the urinary/bladder region considered a vital anatomical site (Basti Marma).
properties.name: Bastimarm Abhighataja Vatavyadhi

properties.Description: An Ayurvedic description of a mass or nodular swelling involving the testicular region (Beejakosha).
properties.name: Beejakosha Granthi

properties.Description: Ayurvedic term for fracture or disruption of the continuity of a bone, generally associated with trauma.
properties.name: Bhagna

properties.Description: Infertility described as resulting from depletion or inadequate nourishment of the bodily tissues (Dhatus) affecting reproductive capacity.
properties.name: Dhatukshayajanya Vandhyata

properties.Description: A chronic or complicated form of nasal disorder with persistent discharge and inflammation, described under Pratishyaya.
properties.name: Dushta Pratishyaya

properties.Description: A chronic or contaminated/non-healing wound characterized by abnormal discharge, inflammation, pain, or delayed healing.
properties.name: Dushta Vrana

properties.Description: Ekakushtha is a type of Kshudrakushtha representing minor skin disorders that are typically less severe but still require attention.
properties.name: Ekakushtha

properties.Description: Vata disorders arising from depletion of bodily tissues, allowing Vata to become aggravated and produce pain, weakness, and functional disturbances.
properties.name: Dhatukshayajanya Vatavyadhi

properties.Description: A reproductive disorder characterized by recurrent loss or expulsion of pregnancy, resulting in inability to sustain pregnancy.
properties.name: Garbhasravi Vandhyatva

properties.Description: A disorder of Grahani, the functional site of digestion and intestinal retention, characterized by impaired digestion and irregular bowel movements.
properties.name: Grahani Dosha

properties.Description: A Vata-dominant condition characterized by stiffness, restricted movement, and pain in the neck region.
properties.name: Greevastambha

properties.Description: An Ayurvedic Vata disorder characterized by pain radiating from the lower back through the buttock and along the leg, often associated with stiffness and restricted movement.
properties.name: Gridhrasi

properties.Description: Indralupta is a disease characterized by patches of hair loss spread throughout the body and scalp.
properties.name: Indralupta

properties.Description: A condition described by accumulation of fluid within the abdominal cavity, producing abdominal distension and associated systemic manifestations.
properties.name: Jalodara

properties.Description: Swelling caused predominantly by aggravated Kapha, characterized by heaviness, pallor, coldness, and relatively stable edema.
properties.name: Kaphaja Shotha

properties.Description: A Kapha-dominant form of Unmada (mental disorder) characterized by lethargy, excessive sleep, heaviness, and diminished mental activity.
properties.name: Kaphaja Unmada

properties.Description: A blistering skin disorder involving all three Doshas with predominance of Kapha and Pitta, producing eruptions or blisters.
properties.name: Kapha-Pitta Dominant Tridoshaja Visphota

properties.Description: A condition in which Kapha obstructs the normal function of Udana Vata, affecting speech, effort, strength, and upward bodily functions.
properties.name: Kaphavruta Udanavata

properties.Description: A disorder caused by obstruction of Vata by aggravated Kapha, resulting in impaired Vata movement and associated heaviness and sluggishness.
properties.name: Kaphavruta Vata

properties.Description: A menstrual disorder characterized by painful menstruation, commonly associated with aggravated Vata.
properties.name: Kashtartava

properties.Description: A Vata disorder characterized by stiffness, restricted movement, and pain in the lower back region.
properties.name: Kati Graha

properties.Description: A degenerative Vata disorder affecting the lumbosacral joints, producing pain, stiffness, and restricted movement.
properties.name: Kati Sandhigata Vata

properties.Description: Kitibha Kushta, which is characterized by reddish patches, indurated, Itching, and Scaling.
properties.name: Kitibha Kushta

properties.Description: An acute skin manifestation characterized by raised, itchy eruptions or wheals, associated with Dosha disturbance and resembling urticarial lesions.
properties.name: Kotha

properties.Description: Ksheena Shukra is one of the “Shukradushti” (~vitiation of sperm) where Shukra Dhatu (~reproductive tissue) is of poor quality.
properties.name: Ksheena Shukra

properties.Description: A Prameha disorder characterized by frequent urination with urine having characteristics resembling honey, traditionally associated with deranged metabolism and predominantly Vata involvement.
properties.name: Madhumeha

properties.Description: A chronic, difficult-to-heal wound associated with Madhumeha, characterized by delayed healing and abnormal tissue changes.
properties.name: Madhumehajanaya Dushta Vrana

properties.Description: A visual disorder described as disturbance or impairment of vision associated with Madhumeha, reflecting ocular complications of the condition.
properties.name: Madhumehajanya Timira

properties.Description: A group of severe or major forms of Kushtha (chronic skin disorders) described in classical Ayurvedic texts.
properties.name: Maha Kushta

properties.Description: Mandala Kushtha a type of Maha Kushtha is a chronic of Kushtha
properties.name: Mandala Kushtha

properties.Description: A Vata disorder in which aggravated Vata is located in Mamsa (muscle tissue), producing pain, stiffness, twitching, or weakness.
properties.name: Mansagata Vata

properties.Description: A disorder involving abnormal accumulation or disturbance of Meda (adipose/fat tissue), associated with metabolic imbalance and excessive body weight.
properties.name: Medoroga

properties.Description: An Ayurvedic urinary disorder characterized by painful or difficult urination, often associated with inflammation or obstruction of the urinary tract.
properties.name: Mootrakruchchhra

properties.Description: In Ayurveda, Mutraghata has been defined as a syndrome of obstructive urinary pathology due to deranged function of Vata Dosha, particularly Apana Vata (a type of Vata responsible for excretory function).
properties.name: Mutraghata

properties.Description: A condition characterized by retention or obstruction of urine, with incomplete or delayed urinary evacuation.
properties.name: Mutrasanga

properties.Description: A Vata disorder in which aggravated Vata is localized in the large intestine (Pakvashaya), producing abdominal pain, constipation, distension, and altered bowel function.
properties.name: Pakvashayagata Vata

properties.Description: A group of Ayurvedic metabolic and urinary disorders characterized by excessive or abnormal urination and derangement of bodily tissues, with Madhumeha representing an important subtype.
properties.name: Prameha

properties.Description: A disorder caused by obstruction of Vyana Vata by Prana Vata, disturbing normal circulation and coordinated bodily movements.
properties.name: Prana Avrutta Vyana

properties.Description: A classical wasting disorder characterized by progressive tissue depletion, weakness, cough, fever, and respiratory or systemic manifestations.
properties.name: Rajayakshma

properties.Description: A condition characterized by passage of blood with loose stools, reflecting involvement of Rakta and intestinal pathology.
properties.name: Raktatisara

properties.Description: A Vata disorder in which Rakta (blood tissue) obstructs the normal movement of Vata, producing pain and vascular or inflammatory manifestations.
properties.name: Raktavrita Vata

properties.Description: A degenerative Vata disorder affecting the joints, characterized by pain, stiffness, restricted movement, and sometimes joint crepitus.
properties.name: Sandhigata Vata

properties.Description: Disorders arising from excessive nourishment, overnutrition, and accumulation of Doshas and bodily tissues, commonly associated with obesity and metabolic disease.
properties.name: Santarpanajanya Vyadhi

properties.Description: A severe state of loss of consciousness or profound collapse of mental and physical functions, described as a serious Vata-related condition.
properties.name: Sanyasa

properties.Description: A Vata disorder in which aggravated Vata affects the entire body, producing generalized pain, stiffness, weakness, or functional impairment.
properties.name: Sarvanga Gatavata Vyadhi

properties.Description: A generalized Vata disorder characterized by widespread involvement of the body with pain, stiffness, weakness, and impaired movement.
properties.name: Sarvangavata

properties.Description: A generalized disorder of the oral cavity, involving widespread inflammation or lesions of the oral tissues.
properties.name: Sarvasara Mukharoga

properties.Description: An Ayurvedic ocular disorder characterized by whitish discoloration or opacity affecting ocular structures, resulting in visual disturbance.
properties.name: Savrinashukla

properties.Description: A skin disorder characterized by itchy, raised eruptions associated with exposure to cold, traditionally involving Vata and Kapha with Pitta involvement.
properties.name: Sheethapitta

properties.Description: A disorder arising from trauma to vital structures of the head (Shiro Marma), potentially producing neurological or sensory disturbances.
properties.name: Shiromarmabhighata

properties.Description: A form of Arsha (haemorrhoidal disorder) associated with bleeding, characterized particularly by rectal bleeding.
properties.name: Shonitarsha

properties.Description: Ayurvedic term for inflammatory swelling or edema, characterized by enlargement, discomfort, and Dosha-specific features.
properties.name: Shotha

properties.Description: A Vata disorder affecting the blood vessels or vascular channels (Sira), producing pain, obstruction, or abnormal vascular manifestations.
properties.name: Siragata Vata

properties.Description: An Ayurvedic disorder characterized by excessive accumulation of Meda and increased body bulk, accompanied by impaired metabolism and reduced physical capacity.
properties.name: Sthaulya

properties.Description: A metabolic form of Prameha characterized by excess body tissue and obesity-associated manifestations, commonly involving Kapha and Meda.
properties.name: Sthula Prameha

properties.Description: Samanya Shodhana (General purification) is the preliminary, common purification step applied to many metals, minerals, and toxic herbs using standard media such as water, cow urine, milk, oil, or herbal decoctions. Its purpose is to remove visible impurities, reduce basic toxicity, and make the material softer and suitable for further processing.

properties.Description: Alopecia is the medical term for hair loss. It can mean small round patches missing from the scalp (alopecia areata), total loss of head hair (alopecia totalis), or loss of all body hair (alopecia universalis).
properties.name: Alopecia

properties.Description: Piles, also known as haemorrhoids, are swollen and enlarged veins in the lower rectum or anus. They may cause rectal bleeding, discomfort, itching, or a lump around the anal region.

In the final formulation Swasanandam Gutika, aconitine was not detected, confirming significant detoxification and improved safety after purification.
Shodhita Vatsanabha showed fewer spots at both 254 nm and 366 nm, indicating denaturation/removal of toxic alkaloids, suggesting cow urine is a more effective purification medium than cow's milk.
Shodhana of Gunja seeds with lemon juice showed greater physico-chemical changes and more detectable components than raw and water-processed samples.
HPTLC confirmed the presence of Abrine in unprocessed seeds, and fingerprint comparison showed qualitative phytochemical changes after Shodhana.

HPTLC showed altered chromatographic fingerprints after Shodhana, with fewer spots at both 254 nm and 366 nm and changes in Rf values, indicating denaturation/removal of certain constituents, thereby supporting detoxification of Gunja seeds.
HPTLC analysis confirmed a significant reduction in strychnine and brucine levels in purified seeds, with greater reduction observed after purification in Ardraka swarasa compared to Kanji.
HPTLC analysis showed that all Shodhana methods reduced strychnine and brucine levels compared to raw seeds, with the cow's urine followed by cow milk sequential method showing the maximum reduction.

The HPTLC fingerprint changed after Shodhana, with the number of spots reducing from 5 (raw) to 3 (processed) at 254 nm, indicating alteration/removal of phytochemical constituents.

Noticeable changes in chromatographic profile indicating reduction of toxic constituents after Shodhana.

properties.Procedure: After the first heating cycle, purified pearl was ground with cow's milk, made into pellets, and subjected to repeated Laghu Puta cycles until Bhasma was obtained.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Shodhita Swarna Makshika was mixed with Kajjali (a fine black mixture of purified mercury and sulphur) and triturated with lemon juice, then heated in a sealed bottle (Kupipaka) for 10 hours. The bottom material was further heated six more times to obtain the final Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Shodhita Swarna Makshika was triturated with lemon juice (Bhavana), formed into pellets, sealed in earthen containers (Sharava Samputa), subjected to 11 controlled heating cycles with self cooling to obtain ash (Bhasma).

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Shodhita Tamra was triturated with Kajjali (a fine black mixture of purified mercury and sulphur) using lemon juice, dried, sealed, and subjected to three graded heating cycles with re-trituration between each Puta to obtain Tamra Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Shodhita Tamra was mixed with Kajjali (a fine black mixture of purified mercury and sulphur), triturated with lemon juice, pelletized, sealed in earthen containers, and incinerated at 700°C (first cycle) and 650°C (subsequent cycles) for six total Puta to obtain Tamra Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Purified copper was triturated with equal Kajjali for first three heating cycles and with equal purified sulfur for the next four cycles using lemon juice as levigation medium, pelletized and subjected to graded Puta heating in EMF to get Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Shodhita Tamra was triturated with sulphur, Kajjali, and lemon juice and subjected to incineration to prepare Tamra Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Purified copper was mixed with Kajjali, sulphur and triturated with lemon juice, sealed in earthen container, and subjected to repeated Puta (incineration) in an electrical muffle furnace to obtain Tamra Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Jarita Yashada was triturated with Kajjali (mercury–sulphur mixture), levigated with Aloe vera and lemon juice, pelletized, sealed in earthen pot, and subjected to incineration to obtain Yashada Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Purified Swarna Makshika was triturated with sulphur and lemon juice, pelletized, sealed in earthen pot, and subjected to repeated Puta heating cycles (9 cycles) to obtain Swarna Makshika Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Jarita Naga was triturated with equal Manashila and lemon juice, pelletized, sealed in Earthen pot and subjected to 60 repeated cycles of calcination for Naga Bhasma formation.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Copper was first amalgamated with mercury using lemon juice, then mixed with sulphur to form Kajjali, sealed in Kupi Yantra (glass bottle coated with layered mud-smeared cloth) and heated (~700 °C for 9 h) to obtain fine Tamra Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Equal parts of purified Vaikranta and sulphur were triturated with lemon juice to form a paste, pelletized, dried, then sealed inside closed earthen containers and repeatedly heated at high temperature using cow-dung fuel for eight cycles to obtain Vaikrānta Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: The purified eggshell powder was triturated with lemon juice for 2 days, pelletized and subjected to 2 heat cycles, then the material was again triturated with Aloe vera pulp for 2 days, re-pelletized and subjected to 3 additional heat cycles to obtain fine Kukkutanda Twak Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Purified lead was mixed with 1/4 part purified mercury and equal part purified sulphur, triturated with lemon juice to form a paste, made into pellets, dried and subjected to repeated incineration for 30 cycles to obtain Naga Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Purified zinc was amalgamated with purified mercury, mixed with purified sulphur and levigated with lemon juice and aloe vera juice, pelletized and subjected to four incineration cycles.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Purified Swarna Makshika was triturated with lemon juice and subjected to 11 calcination cycles using cow-dung cakes as the heat source to obtain Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Purified Swarna Makshika and purified sulphur were triturated with lemon juice, pellets were prepared and sun-dried. These pellets were sealed in earthen crucibles and incinerated using cow dung cakes, with intermediate trituration in lemon juice; the cycle was repeated 5 times.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Shodhita Tamra was mixed with Kajjali (a fine black mixture of purified mercury and sulphur), triturated with lemon juice, pelletized, sealed in earthen containers, and incinerated for 3 Puta to obtain Tamra Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Shodhita Tamra was boiled in lemon juice, triturated with mercury and sulphur, coated with Punarnava paste, sealed in earthen pots and heated, then re-triturated with Surana kanda juice and subjected to 3 calcination cycles with sulphur and ghee to obtain Tamra Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Jarita Vanga was triturated with Haratala churna in lemon juice, made into thin pellets, sealed in Earthen pots, and subjected to 10 calcination cycles to obtain Vanga Bhasma.

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
properties.name: Marana

properties.Procedure: Shodhita Swarna Makshika was mixed with lemon juice (Bhavana), made into pellets, sealed in a clay container, and subjected to 12 controlled heating cycles to convert it into ash (Bhasma).

properties.Process_Description: Marana is the calcination of purified metals and minerals through repeated cycles of grinding with herbal media and controlled heating (Puta). This converts the material into fine, ash-like Bhasma that is non-toxic, stable, and bioavailable.
